import asyncio
from agnes_provisioner.script_contract import ScriptFailure

async def run(ctx):
    ctx.log('本地受控示例，不访问真实网站。', stage='prepare')
    await asyncio.sleep(float(ctx.parameters['delay']))
    if ctx.index in ctx.parameters['fail_indices']:
        raise ScriptFailure('DEMO_FAILURE', '预设失败，用于核对不补数量。')
    password = 'demo-password-' + str(ctx.index)
    key = 'demo-key-' + str(ctx.index)
    ctx.register_secret(password)
    ctx.register_secret(key)
    ctx.mark_submitted()
    return {'account': 'demo-' + str(ctx.index), 'password': password, 'api_key': key}

async def close(ctx):
    ctx.log('示例资源已清理。', stage='cleanup')
